definitions.gloss: exchange, back-and-forth, trading (of words, arguments, blows)
definitions.explanation: A heated or sustained exchange between two parties. Most commonly refers to verbal exchanges such as arguments, retorts, or debate, but can also refer to physical exchanges like blows in a fight.

examples.japanese: {激|はげ}しい{応酬|おうしゅう}が{続|つづ}いた。
{国会|こっかい}で{与野党|よやとう}の{応酬|おうしゅう}が{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げられた。
examples.english: An exchange between the ruling and opposition parties unfolded in parliament.

examples.japanese: {記者|きしゃ}{会見|かいけん}で{質問|しつもん}と{応酬|おうしゅう}が{一時間|いちじかん}も{続|つづ}き、{会場|かいじょう}は{緊張|きんちょう}に{包|つつ}まれた。
examples.english: Questions and exchanges went on for an hour at the press conference, and the venue was filled with tension.

notes:
{応酬|おうしゅう} describes a back-and-forth exchange, typically confrontational in nature.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {激|はげ}しい{応酬|おうしゅう}: fierce exchange
- {言葉|ことば}の{応酬|おうしゅう}: verbal exchange
- {批判|ひはん}の{応酬|おうしゅう}: exchange of criticism
- {応酬|おうしゅう}を{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる: to engage in an exchange

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {応酬|おうしゅう}: confrontational exchange, trading of words or blows
- {やり取|と}り: exchange, back-and-forth (neutral, everyday)
- {論戦|ろんせん}: debate, war of words (formal, political)
